description: Grassland degradation status classification schema. Positive codes indicate degradation, negative codes indicate recovery, 0 is stable.

severe_degradation.description: Severe degradation: NDVI declining >0.02/yr for 3+ years
severe_degradation.recommendation: Immediate restoration: grazing exclusion, reseeding, soil conservation

moderate_degradation.description: Moderate degradation: NDVI declining 0.01-0.02/yr for 3+ years
moderate_degradation.recommendation: Priority restoration: reduced grazing pressure, rotational grazing

light_degradation.description: Light degradation: NDVI declining 0.005-0.01/yr for 3+ years
light_degradation.recommendation: Preventive management: monitor, adjust stocking rate

light_recovery.description: Light recovery: NDVI increasing 0.005-0.01/yr for 2+ years
light_recovery.recommendation: Monitor and maintain: continue current practices

moderate_recovery.description: Moderate recovery: NDVI increasing 0.01-0.02/yr for 2+ years
moderate_recovery.recommendation: Positive trajectory: document and replicate management

significant_recovery.description: Significant recovery: NDVI increasing >0.02/yr for 2+ years
significant_recovery.recommendation: Success case: use as reference for other areas

trend_methods.theil-sen: Robust non-parametric slope (median of pairwise slopes). Recommended for noisy remote sensing data.
trend_methods.ols: Ordinary Least Squares. Sensitive to outliers but efficient for clean data.
trend_methods.mann-kendall: Normalized Kendall tau. Non-parametric trend strength indicator.

climate_normalization.description: Separates climate-driven vegetation variation from management-driven change using residual trend analysis.
climate_normalization.method: OLS regression of NDVI against precipitation and temperature anomalies, then trend of residuals.
climate_normalization.reference: Fensholt & Proud 2012, Remote Sensing of Environment

baci_design.description: Before-After-Control-Impact analysis for management effectiveness evaluation.
baci_design.requirement: Requires treatment area, control area, and intervention start year.
